## Body

Security verdict, #315 round 2 at 7d79009. Read-only review of the delta 916de56..7d79009; nothing built.

R315-F001 (eeb09214): `receipt.after` is now `registry.list(live()).len()` instead of a full list filtered to `tombstoned_at.is_none()` in Rust. Round 1 showed that LIST_LIVE_SQL returns the same rows as LIST_SQL with live_only set, and the old Rust filter kept exactly those rows. So the count is identical. `after` is only a number in the receipt: it is computed after the loop, and nothing reads it to choose what to tombstone, notify or revive. What the sweep acts on and what it reports are unchanged. Inputs stay bound parameters. A missing index still fails closed (list returns Err and the sweep errors).

New test (reaper_tests.rs): a list spy over the real store. It has no process launches, no paths and no secrets, so it is safe for a public repo.

Merge 7d79009c: #313 (8b437897) is on origin/main. `git diff origin/main...HEAD` touches only F258's 9 files (the migration, migrate.rs, registry.rs, the reaper and its tests, the two store tests, one difficulties row and the retro), so the merge brings in nothing unreviewed. The difficulties.md conflict resolved to a single added row (D-F258-4) on top of main's D-F258-3.
